title: LTX-2.5 Studio
kicker: TEXT · IMAGE · FIRST + LAST FRAME · SYNCHRONIZED AUDIO · LOCAL GPU
hero: Type it, frame it, or bracket it. The sound comes with.
description: LTX-2.5 runs the official distilled two-stage recipe in one private Comfy runtime: text-to-video and image-to-video generate at half resolution, run the x2 latent spatial upscaler, refine with the second sigma stage, and decode video plus synchronized audio in one pass. First + last frame brackets both endpoints natively at full resolution.
guide: Choose Text to video for an open prompt, Image to video when one still should begin the clip, or First + last frame when both endpoints are known and the middle must be invented. Every mode emits one MP4-class file with its audio track attached; nothing leaves the machine.
engine: LTX-2.5 22B Distilled · INT8 ConvRot / NVFP4 · Gemma 4 12B projection encoder · x2 latent upscale
runtime_contract: RTX 5090 · local Comfy graph · GPU inference · Comfy-managed weight offload

setup_steps: Run `cd ~/multimedia/workflows && .venv/bin/python download_models.py ltx` to install the allowlisted LTX-2.5 bundle from the ungated comfyicu mirror of Lightricks/LTX-2.5. The weights remain under the LTX-2.x Community License.
Run `cd ~/multimedia/workflows/ltx && ./setupwithuv.sh` once. The command prepares the isolated GPU environment against the shared Comfy checkout.
Run `./startwithuv.sh` and open the printed loopback URL.
Use Text to video for open prompts, Image to video to start from a still, and First + last frame to bracket a known beginning and ending.

modes.title: Text to video
modes.short: Describe a clip with synchronized sound; the distilled recipe samples it in two stages.
modes.description: The official T2V template: half-resolution sampling with the distilled DiT, the x2 latent spatial upscaler between stages, the second sigma schedule, tiled decode, and one CreateVideo pass that attaches the decoded audio track.
modes.recipe: Write what should happen, how it looks, and what sounds it makes. The enhancer toggle rewrites the prompt through the small E2B encoder first, exactly like the official template's optional path.

fields.label: Clip description
fields.default: A cinematic close-up of a candle flame in a dark room. The flame sways gently as a draft passes; warm light moves across the wall behind it. Soft ambient room tone with a faint crackle.
fields.hint: Describe visuals and sound together; the model generates both in one pass.

fields.label: Prompt enhancement
fields.toggle_label: Rewrite the prompt with the E2B enhancer
fields.hint: Off by default, like the official template. Loads a second small encoder when on.

fields.label: Duration
fields.hint: Frames = seconds × FPS + 1, capped at 1,000 by the audio latent ceiling.

modes.title: Image to video
modes.short: Start from a still and let the model direct the rest, sound included.
modes.description: The official I2V template: the first frame is resized to a 1536 longer side, compressed with LTXVPreprocess, pinned into the latent at stage strength 0.7, sampled through the same two-stage distilled recipe, and re-pinned at strength 1.0 after the x2 upsample before decode.
modes.recipe: Drop the exact opening frame you want. The model keeps it fixed while inventing motion and sound; describe the movement and audio you expect next.

fields.label: First frame
fields.hint: Resized to a 1536 longer side internally, matching the official template.

fields.label: What happens next
fields.default: The camera drifts slowly forward while the subject moves naturally; lighting stays coherent. Ambient sound matches the scene.

modes.title: First + last frame
modes.short: Bracket a known beginning and ending; the model invents the middle.
modes.description: The official FLF2V template: both frames are resized to the exact canvas, compressed with LTXVPreprocess, and pinned through LTXVAddGuide at strength 0.7 (frame 0 and frame -1). Sampling runs the single-stage schedule with Euler ancestral, then crops the guides and decodes video plus audio.
modes.engine: Distilled 22B · dual frame pinning · single-stage sigmas
modes.recipe: Drop the exact opening and closing frames. Use them for transitions, product loops, and anything where both endpoints are already decided.
